VISITE // SALLE DE LA CHORALE, PAROISS: VISIT  //  CHOIR HALL, SAINT AGATHA PARISH
Cliquez sur un endroit de l'image pour l: Click a spot on the image to examine it. What you find is added to the file.
La salle de répétition de Sainte-Agathe,:
The Saint Agatha rehearsal room, the day after the vigil. Ewa TILL is putting scores away, unhurried.

"You've come about Sunday evening. Come in, inspector. There is nothing to hide here."

You can examine four places.
Sur le pupitre, la partition de la veill: On the stand, the score from the vigil, annotated in Ewa TILL's hand: "Office of Saint Agatha, 9 November". It was not a random song, but the feast of the parish's patron saint.
La feuille d'émargement, près de l'entré: The attendance sheet, by the entrance
La feuille de présence de la veillée, la: The attendance sheet from the vigil, left on the lectern by the entrance. Seven people signed by hand. Not eleven. Two lines are marked "excused".
Épinglé au panneau, l'avis du Bureau des: Pinned to the board, the notice from the Bureau of Religious Affairs: vigil permit no. 86/212, issued on 14 October. Next to it, a note from the choir: "get well soon, Roman FALK, hospital no. 2".
Pliée au fond d'un tiroir de la sacristi: Folded at the bottom of a sacristy drawer, an old application for the post of titular organist, dated 1985, in the name of Ignác KOLB. The parish council has written on it, in pencil: "post given to Mrs TILL".
Son livre de cantiques, ouvert. Dedans,: Her hymn book, open. Inside, a photo of Josef TILL in a railwayman's uniform and a sprig of dried heather. Ewa TILL watches you close it. Nothing for the file.
On the threshold, Ewa TILL sees you out. "KOLB wanted the organ. He didn't get it. Singing for a saint is not a crime." She closes the door without a sound.
